## Topilgan faktlar

**1. "Hammasi" tabi xodimlarni ko'rsatmaydi.** [users.service.js:146](server/src/modules/users/services/users.service.js#L146):

```js
filter.role = role || { $in: [ROLES.STUDENT, ROLES.TEACHER] };

Ya'ni "Hammasi" = o'quvchi + o'qituvchi qo'shilgani, xolos. "Xodim qo'shish" bilan yaratilgan direktor/buxgalter ro'yxatda **umuman ko'rinmaydi** (bu oldindan mavjud kamchilik, men kiritganim emas). Demak "Hammasi" tabini olib tashlash hech narsa yo'qotmaydi — sidebar allaqachon ajratilgan.

**2. Kerakli pattern allaqachon bor.** [TeacherSalariesPage.jsx:18](client/src/owner/features/teacherSalary/pages/TeacherSalariesPage.jsx#L18) tabni ruxsat bo'yicha kesadi:

```js
if (has("groups.update")) items.push({ to: `${BASE}/maosh-belgilash`, ... });

**Natija**

Katta talab to'plami. Ko'pi allaqachon mavjud bo'lishi mumkin — avval nima borligini aniqlayman va council'ni chaqiraman.

Ko'pi allaqachon qurilgan — ko'rmayotganingizning sababi bazada **1 ta filial** bor. Eng og'ir arxitektura savoli bo'yicha council'ni chaqiraman.

To'liq manzara oydin. Council va kod tahlili natijasi:

## Talablar holati

| # | Talab | Holat |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Sidebar'da "Barcha filiallar" + filial tanlash | ✅ **Allaqachon bor** |
| 2 | Har bir filial ma'lumoti alohida | ✅ Bor, test bilan tasdiqlangan |
| 3 | Umumiy hisobot faqat "Barcha filiallar"da | ❌ Yo'q |
| 4 | Filialsiz tizimda ishlamasin | ✅ O'tgan safar qilindi |
| 5 | Direktorga har xil access, yangi rolsiz | ❌ Yo'q — **eng katta ish** |
| 6 | Filial: edit / o'chirish / muzlatish / parol | ⚠️ Qisman |
| 7 | Administrator qaysi filialda ekanini bilsin | ❌ Yo'q |

**№1 ni ko'rmayotganingizning sababi:** [BranchSwitcher.jsx](client/src/shared/components/layout/BranchSwitcher.jsx) allaqachon "Barcha filiallar" + filiallar ro'yxatini beradi, lekin `hasMultipleBranches` sharti bilan yashirinadi — bazangizda **1 ta filial** ("xiuhc") bor. Ikkinchi filial ochsangiz darhol chiqadi.

## Asosiy kamchilik — №5

Bugun ruxsat faqat **roldan** keladi (`req.permissions = effectiveRole.permissions`, [auth.js:87](server/src/middleware/auth.js#L87)). Andijon direktoriga moliya, Farg'ona direktoriga yo'q desangiz — ikkita rol yaratishga majbursiz. Siz aynan shuni istamaysiz.

Gemini uchta variantdan **b** ni tanladi va men ham roziman: `branchAssignments[]` ichiga `grant[]` / `revoke[]` qo'shish. Sabab — foydalanuvchi vakolati allaqachon filial konteksti bilan belgilangan, ya'ni "Andijonda moliyachi, Farg'onada oddiy direktor" tabiiy ifodalanadi.

```
Amaldagi ruxsat = (rol.permissions ∪ grant) \ revoke
`

Tushundim — tuzatishga o'tmay, testni davom ettiraman. Aniq aytgan bo'shliq qolgan edi: pul matematikasi uchun property/fuzz testi. Avval kodni yana bir bor o'qib, tekshiriladigan invariantlarni aniqlayman.

Gipoteza tasdiqlandi va bu muhim: `proratedFee` **clamp qilinmagan**, lekin `factor` clamp qilingan — ya'ni kunlar oshib ketsa, o'quvchi ortiqcha hisoblanadi, UI esa xotirjam `1.0` ko'rsatadi. Buni fuzz test bilan tekshiraman.

Tasdiqlandi: kesishgan davrlarda **2 barobar ortiqcha hisoblash**, `factor` esa xotirjam `1.0`. Endi hal qiluvchi savol — bunday kesishuv haqiqiy ma'lumotda yuz bera oladimi? Buni tekshirmasdan jiddiyligini ayta olmayman.

Muhim nuans: unique indeks faqat bitta **faol** a'zolikni cheklaydi (`leftAt: null`). Yopilgan (leftAt to'ldirilgan) a'zoliklar cheklanmaydi — demak kesishuv indeksdan o'tib ketadi. Amalda yuz bera oladimi, tekshiray.

`joinedAt` mijozdan to'liq boshqariladi (`addStudent.validator.js` da majburiy maydon). Lekin 976-980 qatorlarda kesishuv tekshiruvi bordek — hal qiluvchi joy. O'qiyman.

Yozish yo'lida `assertPeriodInvariants` qo'riqchisi bor — demak `addStudent` orqali kesishuv yaratib bo'lmaydi. Lekin barcha yozish yo'llari shu qo'riqchidan o'tadimi? Hal qiluvchi savol shu.

Barcha API yozish yo'llari qo'riqlangan (`removeStudent` ham `leftAt`ni bugunga qo'yadi, ixtiyoriy sana emas). Demak bu **ekspluatatsiya qilinadigan xato emas** — himoya qatlami muammosi. Testdagi izohni haqqoniy qilib to'g'rilayman.

Endi hali qilmagan Faza 3 — poyga holatlari. To'lov yaratishda atomiklik bormi, tekshiray.

Bu klassik "tekshir-keyin-bajar" poygasi: ikkita bir vaqtdagi so'rov ikkalasi ham `existing` topmasligi mumkin. `idempotencyKey` da unique indeks bormi — hal qiluvchi savol.

Unique partial indeks bor — poyga DB darajasida to'silad

**The requested columns don't match this codebase's finance model.** There is no `Expense` or `Other Income` model at all — money leaving the system is only salary payments and deposit withdrawals, recorded as `Approval` command-logs. And `TeacherSalary` has no `bonus`/`penalty`/`totalSalary` fields: `expectedAmount` is *computed* by `recalc()` from group revenue and proration, per teacher **+ group** + month. Student payments likewise must flow through `transaction.service.create()` — the allocation engine that spreads money across unpaid months oldest-first and pushes overflow to deposit. Inserting raw rows would corrupt the ledger.

So I'm building the reusable engine + full UX as specified, with importers that write through the real services. I'll detail what I deliberately did not build at the end.

Confirmed — the salary service returns `{pendingApproval: true}` when over the branch expense limit. My importer must treat that as a valid outcome, not an error. Building the generic reader first.

## 1. Ko'rayotganingizning 95% i shablon

```
Jami insight              : 454

Gemini yozgan             :  23   (5%)

| Ekranda ko'rayotganingiz | Manbasi |
|---|---|
| Brifing (kecha / bugun / keyin / hozir) izohlari | `lines.join(" ")` — **sof JS shablon** |
| Kunlik / haftalik / oylik hisobot matni | **shablon** |
| Reytinglar, Health Score, prognoz, Action Center | **deterministik hisob** |
| Insight kartasidagi izoh matni | ⬅️ **faqat shu yerda LLM bo'lishi mumkin** |

Filial telefoni allaqachon ixtiyoriy (client `isValid` faqat nomni talab qiladi, zod schema’da ham `.optional()`). Lekin bitta tuzoq bor: telefon maskasi chala to‘ldirilganda (`+998`, `+998 (90`) qiymat baribir yuboriladi — va direktor bloki bilan birga yuborilsa server `normalizePhone` orqali uni rad etib, **filial yaratilishini butunlay to‘xtatadi**:

Lint toza. Nima qilindi:

**Holat:** filial telefoni allaqachon ixtiyoriy edi — client’da `isValid` faqat `name` ni talab qiladi ([BranchCreateModal.jsx:78](client/src/owner/features/branches/components/modals/BranchCreateModal.jsx#L78)), serverda ham `phone: z.string().max(30).optional().nullable()` ([create.validator.js:29](server/src/modules/branches/validators/create.validator.js#L29)).

**Asl muammo:** `+{998} (00) 000-00-00` maskasi maydonga tegilganda chala qiymat qoldiradi (`+998`, `+998 (90`). U qiymat baribir yuborilardi va:
- filial telefoni sifatida bazaga axlat bo‘lib saqlanardi;

Ro'yxatda turib ikkinchi kartochkaga o'tsangiz React Router komponentni **qayta mount qilmaydi** (bir xil route, boshqa param) — filtr eski holatda qotib qolardi. # 🔴 1. Kesishgan maosh stavkalari → oylik ikki barobar

**Eng jiddiy. API orqali yetib bo'ladi. Men kiritgan.**

[amendCompensation](server/src/modules/teacherSalary/services/teacherCompensation.service.js) da `effectiveFrom` ni **hech qanday tekshiruvsiz** o'zgartirish mumkin:

```js
if (patch.effectiveFrom !== undefined) doc.effectiveFrom = toUtcMidnight(patch.effectiveFrom);
// ... kesishuv tekshiruvi YO'Q
```

**Ketma-ketlik:**
```
1. Stavka A ochiladi   → 1-yanvar, ochiq
2. Stavka B ochiladi   → A 1-martda yopiladi, B 1-martdan
3. PATCH /compensations/B  { effectiveFrom: "2025-02-01" }
   → A: yanvar–mart,  B: fevral–ochiq   ← KESISHDI
```

**Natija (o'lchandim):**

| | Kutilgan | Haqiqiy |
|---|---|---|
| Mart kunlari | 31 | **62** |
| Fiksa oylik 2 mln | 2 000 000 | **4 000 000** |

`segmentPeriod` har bir kesishgan stavka uchun **alohida segment** yaratadi va kunlar qo'shiladi.

**Nega o'tib ketgan:** `TeacherGroupPeriod` va `GroupMembership` da [assertPeriodInvariants](server/src/helpers/period.helper.js) kesishuvni bloklaydi. `TeacherCompensation` da o'sha qo'riqchini qo'ymaganman.

> # Task: Extend Employee Salary System with Flexible Payroll & KPI
>
> ## Context
>
> The system already has:
>
> * Employee Management
> * Custom Roles
> * Permissions & Access Control
> * Teacher Payroll (fully working)
> * Attendance
> * Leads
> * Students
> * Student Payments
>
> Teacher payroll is already implemented and **must not be modified or broken**.
>

>
> The system already has:

> * Employee Management

>

>
> This task is **NOT** about changing salary calculations.
>
> The goal is to make employee history management safe when importing old education centers or editing employee information later.
>
> ---
>
> # Problem
>
> Education centers often migrate from another CRM.
>
> Example:
>
> Group A started:
>
> 01.02.2026
>
> Teacher was hired:
>
> 01.05.2026
>
> The owner imports the existing group and assigns the teacher.
>
> The teacher should receive salary only from the date they actually started working with that group.
>
> ---
>
> Another scenario:
>
> Teacher Employment Date:
>
> 01.05.2026
>
> Later the owner edits it to
>
> 01.01.2025
>
> because they realized the HR information was incorrect.
>
> The system must NOT suddenly generate 16 months of payroll or modify historical salaries automatically.
>
> ---
>
> # Business Rules
>
> ## Rule 1
>
> Employment Date is HR information.
>
> It is NOT a trigger for payroll generation.
>
> Changing Employme
> …

> ## O‘quv Markaz Tizimi — Moliyaviy Hisob Tizimini To‘g‘rilash
>
> Siz senior full-stack developer va buxgalteriya/finance tizimlari bo‘yicha tajribali mutaxassis sifatida ushbu moliyaviy modulni loyihalang.
>
> Bizda o‘quv markazining moliyaviy tizimi mavjud. Tizimda **o‘quvchilar, o‘qituvchilar va boshqa xodimlar** mavjud. Har bir shaxsning markaz bilan o‘zaro moliyaviy balansi bo‘lishi kerak.
>
> ### 1. Boshlang‘ich balans (Opening Balance)
>
> O‘quvchi, o‘qituvchi yoki xodim yaratilayotgan vaqtda uning **boshlang‘ich balansi** kiritilishi kerak.
>
> Masalan:
>
> * `+3,000,000 UZS` → markaz ushbu shaxsga **3 mln so‘m qarzdor**. Ya'ni markaz kelajakda unga 3 mln so‘m berishi kerak.
> * `-3,000,000 UZS` → ushbu shaxs markazga **3 mln so‘m qarzdor**. Ya'ni markaz undan 3 mln so‘m olishi kerak.
> * `0 UZS` → hech qanday boshlang‘ich qarzdorlik mavjud emas.
>
> Bu qiymat shaxsni yaratish jarayonining o‘zida belgilanadi.
>
> ### 2. Nima uchun Opening Balance kerak?
>
> Tizimga yangi shaxs qo‘shilganda, uning markazga kirishidan OLDINGI moliyaviy holatini ham hisobga olishimiz kerak.
>
> Masalan:
>
> O‘qituvchi 2026-yil 1-mayda ishga qabul qilindi.
>
> Ammo markaz va o‘qituvchi o‘rtasida oldindan mavjud bo‘lgan qarzdorlik bor

**Natija**

**Natija**

Let me look at the admin_server's Prisma setup and migration state.

Root cause found: the migration `20260811090000_trial_suspend_usage_liveness` was written but never applied to the local DB. It's purely additive (nullable columns + one index), so `migrate deploy` is the correct, non-destructive fix — no reset, no data loss.

Fixed. It wasn't a code bug — it was a **migration drift**: the schema and services were updated, but the migration was never run against the local DB.

What I did in [admin_server/](admin_server/):

1. `prisma migrate status` → showed `20260811090000_trial_suspend_usage_liveness` pending (adds `Tenant.suspendedAt/suspendReason/suspendLog`, `Subscription.trialDays/trialGrantedBy/trialGrantedAt/trialNote`, `ApiSubscription.lastRequestAt`, plus `Subscription_currentPeriodEnd_idx`).
2. `prisma migrate deploy` — applied it. Deliberately **not** `migrate dev` / `db push`, since those can prompt a reset; `deploy` only replays the recorded SQL. The migration is purely additive (nullable columns + index), so no data was touched.
3. `prisma migrate diff` → **No difference detected** — schema.prisma and DB are now in sync.
4. `prisma generate` — client regenerated.
5. Verified the three columns exist directly in Postgres.

One thing left on your side: **restart the admin_server process** so it picks up the regenerated client and reconnects — I don't start servers unless you ask. After restart, `TenantsService.findAll`, `ApiServicesService.listServices`, and the `SubscriptionSchedulerService` (15-min job) should all stop erroring.

To avoid this recurring: your deploy/start path for admin_server should run `prisma migrate deploy` before boot — right now nothing guarantees migrations are applied before the app queries the new columns.

## Uchta yangi sahifa

**`/owner/cash-desk` — Kassa.** Qoldiqlar, smena, inkassatsiya bitta sahifada. # MongoDB → PostgreSQL (Prisma): poydevor va birinchi modul

Tenant serveri Mongo'dan Postgres'ga ko'chirila boshladi. Bu tur **poydevorni** qo'ydi va uni haqiqiy baza ustida tekshirdi.

## Hajm

| | |
|---|---|
| `server/src` | 74 134 qator, 830 fayl |
| Mongoose modellari | 74 ta → **78 Prisma modeli** |
| Aggregate quvurlari | 114 ta |
| `.populate()` | 150 ta |
| Mongo `$` operatorlari | 1 771 ta |

## Qilingani

**To'liq schema.** 74 model ko'chirildi, `prisma validate` o'tdi. Qidiriladigan ichki massivlar alohida jadvalga chiqarildi — `GroupScheduleItem` (joblar `schedule.day` bo'yicha qidiradi), `UserBranchAssignment` (8+ joyda filtr), `JournalLine` (hisob qoldig'i shu ustunga tayanadi), `DebtWriteOffBreakdown`.

**Pul xavfsizligi.** Prisma qisman unique indeksni deklarativ qo'llab-quvvatlamaydi, shuning uchun 35 tasi xom SQL migratsiyasida. Eng nozigi — **NULL semantikasi**: Mongo `null` ni oddiy qiymat deb sanaydi, Postgres esa `NULL != NULL`. Ya'ni Mongo'dagi bitta indeks bu yerda **ikkitaga** bo'linadi. E'tibor berilmasa "bitta filialga ikkita kassa hisobi" yoki "bir oyda ikkita to'lov rejasi" jimgina o'tib ketardi. 10 ta stsenariy baza ustida sinaldi — hammasi kutilgandek.

**Agenda olib tashlandi.** U faqat Mongo bilan ishlaydi, ya'ni qolsa Mongo ham qolardi. O'rniga pg-boss, lekin **Agenda API'si ataylab saqlangan** (`define/every/now/schedule`) — shu sabab 23 job fayli va chaqiruvchi servislar umuman o'zgarmadi.

**TTL yo'qoldi.** Mongo eskirgan hujjatni o'zi o'chirardi; Postgres'da bunday narsa yo'q. `ttlCleanup.job.js` qo'shildi — busiz `caches`, `refresh_tokens`, `ai_runs`, `ai_usage_logs` cheksiz o'sardi va buni hech qanday xato bildirmasdi.

**Kalit formati saqlandi.** 24-belgili hex (`gen_object_id()` SQL funksiyasi) — `cuid()` ga o'tish 14 ta zod validatorni va frontend marshrutlarini birdaniga buzardi. Javobda `_id` taxallusi ham qoldi.

**Provisioning.** Har tenantga endi alohida Postgres bazasi ochiladi, `migrate deploy` bilan migratsiya qilinadi, deprovision'da faol ulanishlar uzilib drop qilinadi.

**auth moduli** to'liq ko'chirildi — 16/16 test haqiqiy Postgres ustida.

## Yo'l-yo'lakay topilgan xato

Refresh token bir sekund ichida **takrorlanardi**: `signRefresh` bir xil payload'dan bayt-bayt bir xil JWT yasaydi (`iat` faqat sekund aniqligida), `tokenHash` esa unique. "Kirish → darhol yangilash" oqimi unique constraint bilan yiqilardi. Bu **Mongo davridan beri bor edi**, shunchaki odam tezligida ko'rinmasdi. Tuzatildi: payload'ga `jti`.

## Qolgani

43 modul, 23 job, bot, seedlar va 33 eski test hali Mongoose'da — modul ko'chirilmagunicha server to'liq ko'tarilmaydi. Tartib va ko'chirish qoidalari: `server/MIGRATION.md`.

**What's actually in scope:**

| Layer | Size |
|---|---|
| `server/src` total | **74,134 LOC** across 830 files |
| Mongoose models | **74 models**, 6.3k LOC |

| Aggregation pipelines | **114** |
| `.populate()` calls | **150** |
| `ObjectId` references | **439** |
| Mongo `$` operators | **1,771** |
| Test suites to keep green | 34 |

One thing that surfaced that's easy to miss: this is a **multi-tenant SaaS**. `admin_server` provisions a **separate MongoDB per tenant** via shell scripts (`provision.sh`, `deprovision.sh`, `reconfigure.sh`, `settings.service.ts` renders `MONGO_URL`). Switching `server` to PostgreSQL breaks that pipeline unless it migrates too — per-tenant DB creation, `prisma migrate deploy` on release, and DB drop on deprovision.

Straight answer on timeline: rewriting 114 aggregations, 150 populates and 1,771 operators is a multi-session effort. I won't fake it by emitting 190 half-checked files — that yields a system that starts and then fails at runtime. I'll build it in verified layers, foundation first.

- `branchAccess.helper.js` — `ensureMainBranch()` boot'ni yiqitayotgan edi
- `middleware/auth.js` — `requireAuth` (+ `branchAssignments` relation'i include qilindi, aks holda ko'p filialli biriktirish jimgina ishlamay qolardi)
- `userProfile.helper.js` — `/auth/me` (+ `telegramId` BigInt → Number, aks holda JSON seriyalashda 500 berardi)
- `index.js` — boot tekshiruvi

Qolgan 43 modulni ko'chirish ~54k qator kod (114 aggregate, 150 populate, 1771 operator) — bu bir necha sessiyalik ish. Sizda ikki yo'l bor va bu tanlov ishning shaklini o'zgartiradi:

# Migratsiya auditi: 22 tasdiqlangan bug va ularning ildizi

54 agentli sud-ekspertiza auditi ishga tushirildi — har topilma mustaqil skeptik tomonidan **rad etishga urinilib** tekshirildi. 45 topilmadan 22 tasi tasdiqlandi, qolgani rad etildi (asosan "hali ko'chirilmagan modul" — bu bug emas).

## 22 topilma → 5 ta ildiz

**1. `withLegacyId` YUZAKI edi** (13 topilma shundan). Mongo `.populate("requestedBy", {...})` ichki hujjatni HAR DOIM `_id` bilan qaytarardi. Prisma `include: { select: {...} }` esa faqat so'ralganini beradi. Natija: `approval.requestedBy._id` — `undefined`, klientdagi `String(a.requestedBy?._id || a.requestedBy) === String(user._id)` esa `"[object Object]"` bilan taqqoslanib **hech qachon** to'g'ri kelmasdi. Ya'ni so'rov muallifi o'z so'rovini bekor qila olmasdi, o'z so'roviga esa "Tasdiqlash" tugmasi ko'rinardi. Serializer chuqur qilindi — Date/massiv/null buzilmasligi alohida sinaldi.

**2. Populate shakli buzilgan.** Mongo `.populate("branchId")` maydonning **o'zini** obyektga aylantirardi; Prisma `branchId` ni satr qoldirib, `branch` ni alohida qo'shadi. Frontend `row.branchId?.name` o'qib `undefined` olardi — xonalar va tasdiqlar jadvalida "Filial" ustuni bo'sh. `withPopulatedShape()` qo'shildi.

**3. `getById` larda `_id` umuman yo'q edi** — courses, branches, rooms, archiveReasons, feedbackTypes, leadOptions, notificationTemplates, attendanceSettings. Davomat sozlamalarida bu ayniqsa yomon: forma `useEffect(..., [settings?._id])` ga tayanadi, `_id` bo'lmagach effekt qayta ishlamay, forma saqlangan qiymatni **yuklamasdan** standart qiymatni ko'rsatardi — "Saqlash" bosilsa bazadagi sozlama ustiga yozib yuborardi.

**4. Bitta xususiyat IKKI bazadan o'qiyotgan edi.** `notifications` da inbox ro'yxati Mongo'da, hisoblagich Postgres'da qolgan edi — belgi 0 ko'rsatib, ro'yxatda o'qilmagan xabar turishi mumkin edi. Inbox to'liq ko'chirildi.

**5. Telefon orqali login BEQAROR edi.** Telefon ataylab unique emas (ota va o'g'il bitta raqamdan). Mongo'da sort'siz `findOne` amalda barqaror natija berardi; Postgres'da esa `ORDER BY` siz tartib kafolatlanmaydi va **har `lastLoginAt` UPDATE qatorni siljitadi** — ya'ni ikkinchi urinishda boshqa odamning qatori qaytib, to'g'ri parol ham 401 berardi. `orderBy` + `isActive`/`isDeleted` shartga qo'shildi (fail-closed).

## Yana ikkitasi

**NULL saralash tartibi teskari aylangan.** Mongo BSON'da `null` sonlardan past, Postgres'da esa `DESC` standarti `NULLS FIRST`. "Summa bo'yicha kattadan" saralashda birinchi sahifa to'liq null-summali sozlama so'rovlaridan iborat bo'lib, eng katta chiqim ikkinchi sahifaga tushardi. `nulls: "last"` qo'shildi — lekin **faqat nullable ustunga**, aks holda Prisma validatsiya xatosi beradi (buni sinovda tutdim).

**Eskirgan Mongoose job hali ro'yxatda turgan edi** — har kecha 03:00 da ishlab, 10 s timeout keyin 3 marta qayta urinardi. Olib tashlandi; vazifasini `ttlCleanup` allaqachon qamrab olgan.

## Natija

30 endpoint ishlaydi (audit boshida 22 edi). `leads` ham to'liq ko'chirildi — sahifa ham, lid yaratish ham.

**Natija**

Endi ro'yxatga parolni ham qo'shaman — **ayni** ko'lam qoidasi bilan:

Chegara to'g'ri ishlayapti. Endi kartada parolni ko'rsataman:

Endi kartani ko'z bilan tekshiraman:

Bajarildi — kartada login va parol yonma-yon turibdi: `salombek · salomov`, `boburov · 123456`.

## Nima qilindi

**Parol ro'yxat javobiga qo'shildi**, har filial uchun alohida so'rov emas. `/branches?withManagers=true` endi bitta so'rovda login **va** parolni qaytaradi — aks holda 10 ta filial 10 ta qo'shimcha so'rov degani bo'lardi.

Kartada eng ko'pi bilan ikkita boshqaruvchi ko'rsatiladi, qolgani `+N boshqaruvchi` bo'lib yig'iladi (kartani cho'zib yubormaslik uchun).

## Chegara — bu yerda ehtiyot bo'lish kerak edi

Parolni ro'yxatga qo'shish oson yo'l bilan **allaqachon yopilgan teshikni qayta ochishi mumkin edi**. Kodda `credentialScope.helper.js` bor va u aniq aytadi: `branches.view_all` — bu *hisobot* ruxsati, u parolga o'tkazgich bo'lmasligi kerak; aks holda `view_all` + `admin_access` juftligi butun tarmoq parollarini ochib berardi (`privEscalation.test.js` shu ssenariyni yopgan).

Shuning uchun:

- Parol **faqat** `users.password` ruxsati bilan qo'shiladi;
- va faqat aktyorning **haqiqiy** filiallari doirasida — ro'yxat bazadan qayta o'qiladi, `req.allowedBranchIds` ga ishonilmaydi (chunki `view_all` o'sha ro'yxatning o'zini kengaytiradi);
- haqiqiy `owner` — cheklovsiz.

Qoida ikki nusxada bo'lmasligi uchun `resolveActorBranchIds` `users.service.js` dan `credentialScope.helper.js` ga ko'chirildi — endi `/users/:id/password` ham, filiallar ro'yxati ham **ayni** funksiyani chaqiradi.

Auditga uchta yangi tekshiruv qo'shdim, hammasi o'tdi:

```
✅ A admini: BEGONA filial paroli kelmadi
✅ xodim: boshqaruvchi ma'lumoti umuman kelmadi
✅ bayroqsiz so'rovda `managers` maydoni YO'Q
```

>
> Deleting an entity with historical journal entries must fail rather than silently changing the journal entry.

> Preserve the existing journal immutability behavior.

>
> The current `ON DELETE SET NULL` conflicts with the invariant:
